title: 第149章 这是什么手法？完全看不懂！
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他说这话的时候，语气极其自然，没有任何架子，甚至带着一丝自然而然的敬意。

季伯渊的眼角抽了一下。

一个至少元婴期的修士，对这个炼气期的年轻修士说“有何吩咐”？

这个世界到底怎么了？

张瑀拱手回礼，语气如常：“千机先生，有劳了。这面石壁上有一道上古五行禁制，阵眼一百零八处，环环相扣，强行破解会触发自毁。想请你出手，把这道禁制安全拆掉。”

千机阵师转过身，目光落在那面五色流转的石壁上。

他看了片刻，眉头微微动了一下。

“五元锁天阵。”他的声音很平静，“上古五行禁制里最麻烦的几种之一，布阵的人至少是元婴中期。”

“阵眼一百零八处，分布在石壁表面和山体内部，每一处都跟相邻阵眼相互制衡。暴力破解的后果是把整座山一起炸平。”

这话一出来，在场所有人都倒吸了一口凉气。

季伯渊的脸色变了。

他之前只知道禁制会自毁，却不知道自毁的威力能把整座山炸平。

这座山可是天符宗后山，离宗门大殿不过数里之遥。

如果之前强行破解真的触发了自毁，整个天符宗都会被夷为平地。

二长老的声音有些发紧：“这位道友，你能破吗？”

千机阵师看了他一眼，脸上没有任何表情。

“能破。”他的语气依然平静，“你们站远一些。”

季伯渊立刻转身，对身后所有人挥了挥手。

“所有人后退！退到三十丈外！”

长老们和弟子们纷纷往后退去。

宁霜序也退了出去，但她没有退太远，站在了大约二十丈的位置。

张瑀也往后退了几步，但他没有退太远。他把手机固定在背包带上，镜头稳稳地对准石壁的方向。

直播间里的观众也紧张了起来。

【要破阵了！千机阵师出手了！】

【这个阵法听起来好牛逼，上古五行禁制，炸平一座山的那种】

【我只想知道阵后面藏着什么，会不会有什么上古宝贝？】

【天符宗的人全在往后退，主播就站在旁边，这胆量也是没谁了】

【主播：我有飞剑，见势不妙直接起飞】

When he said this, his tone was extremely natural, without any airs, and even with a hint of natural respect.

Ji Boyuan's eyes twitched.

A monk who is at least in the Nascent Soul stage, says "What are your instructions" to a young monk in this Qi refining stage?

What happened to this world?

Zhang Yu returned the greeting with his hands in his hands and said in the same tone as usual: "Mr. Qianji, thank you for your help. There is an ancient five-element restriction on this stone wall. There are 108 holes in the formation, which are interlocking. Forcibly cracking it will trigger self-destruction. I want you to take action to safely remove this restriction."

The Thousand Machine Formation Master turned around and his eyes fell on the stone wall with flowing colors.

He looked at it for a moment, and his brows moved slightly.

"Five Yuan Heaven-locking Formation." His voice was very calm. "One of the most troublesome types of Five Elements Restrictions in ancient times. The person who set up the formation must be at least in the middle Nascent Soul stage."

"There are one hundred and eight formation eyes, distributed on the surface of the stone wall and inside the mountain. Each one of them checks and balances with the adjacent formation eyes. The consequence of violent attack is to blow up the entire mountain together."

As soon as these words came out, everyone present took a breath.

Ji Boyuan's expression changed.

He only knew that the restriction would self-destruct, but he didn't know that the power of self-destruction could blow up an entire mountain.

This mountain is the back mountain of Tianfu Sect, only a few miles away from the sect's main hall.

If the previous forced cracking really triggered self-destruction, the entire Tianfu Sect would be razed to the ground.

The second elder's voice was a little tight: "Fellow Taoist, can you break it?"

The Thousand Machine Formation Master glanced at him without any expression on his face.

"It can be broken." His tone was still calm, "Stand far away."

Ji Boyuan immediately turned around and waved to everyone behind him.

"Everyone retreat! Back thirty feet away!"

The elders and disciples retreated one after another.

Ning Shuangxu also retreated, but she did not retreat too far and stood about twenty feet away.

Zhang Yu also took a few steps back, but he didn't retreat too far.He fixed his cell phone to the strap of his backpack and pointed the camera steadily in the direction of the stone wall.

The audience in the live broadcast room also became nervous.

【The formation is about to be broken!Thousand Machine Formation Master takes action!】

[This formation sounds so awesome, the ancient Five Elements Restriction, the kind that can blow up a mountain]

[I just want to know what is hidden behind the array. Are there any ancient treasures?】

[Everyone in the Tianfu Sect is retreating, and the anchor is standing next to him. No one else has the courage.]

[Anchor: I have a flying sword. When the situation is bad, I take off directly]
